message: esbuild has install scripts that npm will not run because depcurfew.json does not allow it; esbuild does not need them: it only puts the binary, which esbuild takes from an optional dependency for the platform, in place of the esbuild command and checks that it runs
fix: Add esbuild to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json, and keep optional dependencies installed (no omit=optional in .npmrc, no --omit=optional or --no-optional on the install): esbuild works without its install script then

message: fsevents has install scripts that npm will not run because depcurfew.json does not allow it; fsevents does not need them: it is the node-gyp rebuild that npm adds because the source has a binding.gyp, while the package already contains the built fsevents.node
fix: Add fsevents to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json: fsevents works without its install script, and nothing changes

message: lefthook has install scripts that npm will not run because depcurfew.json does not allow it; they only do a task of the project: it runs lefthook install, which installs the git hooks of the repository (depcurfew checked lefthook 2.2.2; the lockfile has 2.1.0, so check that it works the same)
fix: Add lefthook to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json, and add "prepare": "lefthook install" to scripts in package.json, which npm runs for the project itself on install (its allow-list of dependency scripts does not apply to it; depcurfew does not edit scripts)

message: core-js has install scripts that npm will not run because depcurfew.json does not allow it; the package may need them
fix: Review its scripts: add core-js to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json if it needs them, or to installScripts.deny if it works without them; otherwise replace the package
